SELECT * FROM (SELECT id, invoiceDate, invoiceObject, invoiceAmount, companyType, companyName, companyID, invoiceCompanyName, ticketPoint, ticketPointAmount, isOrderTax, NULL AS Supplier, NULL AS SupplierID, NULL AS customer, NULL AS CustomerID, comments, addtime, userId, UserName, update_time, delFlag, invoiceAmount AS purchaseInvoiceAmount, ticketPoint AS ticketPointCost, ticketPointAmount AS ticketPointCostAmount, NULL AS ticketPointIncome, NULL AS ticketPointIncomeAmount, NULL AS ticketPointDifference, 'invoicein' AS tableName FROM invoicein
UNION
SELECT id, invoiceDate, invoiceObject, invoiceAmount, companyType, companyName, companyID, invoiceCompanyName, ticketPoint, ticketPointAmount, isOrderTax, NULL AS Supplier, NULL AS SupplierID, NULL AS customer, NULL AS CustomerID, comments, addtime, userId, UserName, update_time, delFlag, NULL AS purchaseInvoiceAmount, NULL AS ticketPointCost, NULL AS ticketPointCostAmount, ticketPoint AS ticketPointIncome, ticketPointAmount AS ticketPointIncomeAmount, NULL AS ticketPointDifference, 'invoiceout' AS tableName FROM invoiceout
UNION
SELECT id, invoiceDate, NULL AS invoiceObject, invoiceAmount, NULL AS companyType, NULL AS companyName, NULL AS companyID, invoiceCompanyName, supplierTicketPoint AS ticketPoint, supplierPointAmount AS ticketPointAmount, NULL AS isOrderTax, Supplier, SupplierID, customer, CustomerID, comments, addtime, userId, UserName, update_time, delFlag, invoiceAmount AS purchaseInvoiceAmount, supplierTicketPoint AS ticketPointCost, supplierPointAmount AS ticketPointCostAmount, customerTicketPoint AS ticketPointIncome, customerPointAmount AS ticketPointIncomeAmount, (customerPointAmount - supplierPointAmount) AS ticketPointDifference, 'invoiceother' AS tableName FROM invoiceother) AS tmp
delFlag = 0
AND invoiceDate BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND ( (tableName = 'invoiceother' AND Supplier LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchCompamyName}, '%')) OR (tableName = 'invoiceother' AND customer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchCompamyName}, '%')) OR (tableName = 'invoicein' AND companyName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchCompamyName}, '%')) OR (tableName = 'invoiceout' AND companyName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchCompamyName}, '%')) )
AND invoiceCompanyName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchInvoiceCompanyName}, '%')
ORDER BY invoiceDate DESC
